It operates in the beauty and wellness sector, with a diverse portfolio that includes brands like Parachute, Saffola, Set Wet, and Livon. Marico has a strategy focused on premiumization and innovation, positioning its products in value-added segments rather than commodity ones. The company has successfully transformed Saffola from an edible oil brand into a health and wellness brand, launching health foods like oats and True Elements products. Marico's D2C strategy involves acquiring digital-first brands and maintaining distinct brand identities while benefiting from cost efficiencies at scale. The company's revenue for FY2020-21 was INR 80.5 billion (USD 1.1 billion), with a global presence in over 25 countries.. Premiumization Strategy: Rather than competing in commodity segments, Marico focuses on value-added products. For example, while basic coconut oil is a commodity, Parachute commands premium pricing through superior quality, packaging, and brand trust. This strategy has enabled the company to maintain healthy gross margins. Innovation Pipeline: The company consistently invests in R&D, continuously launching new products and variants. Recent launches in the health foods space (Saffola oats variants, True Elements products) demonstrate their ability to enter new categories successfully. Product & Service Portfolio: Marico, through its brand Saffola, offers a range of health and wellness products including edible oils, pure honey, oats, millet cones, soya chunks, peanut butter, mayonnaise, and muesli. The company also provides hair care products under brands like Parachute, Parachute Advanced, Nihar Naturals, and Livon. Marico's portfolio also includes skin care products like Parachute Advanced Body Lotion and fabric care with Revive. With an aim to further strengthen its presence in the immunity-boosting and ayurvedic segment, Marico, one of India’s leading FMCG companies, has extended its healthy foods portfolio with the launch of Saffola Chyawanprash under Immuniveda banner, its contemporary Ayurvedic range. Recognizing the benefits provided by Chyawanprash described in the ancient Ayurvedic texts, Marico has launched its new product that will take care of the health and well-being of the whole family. Speaking about the new launch Sanjay Mishra, COO- India Sales & CEO- News Business, Marico has said that, “As we have been intensifying our healthy foods portfolio, we have been witnessing exponential growth owing to the superior quality of Saffola as well as the trust our consumers place in us. Taking this a step further, we have launched the all-new Saffola Chyawanprash under our Immuniveda banner, an enriched product that combines the benefits of Ayurveda and the expertise to our consumers who are seeking immunity-boosting products that fit into their hectic lifestyles, to ensure the wellbeing of themselves and their families. Given the success we have seen in our recent product launches under brand Saffola, we are confident of earning the consumers love for Saffola Chyawanprash as well.”. The company also entered the Ayurvedic segment with the Saffola Immuniveda range of Kadha Mix and Golden Turmeric Milk Mix. Further, Marico has forayed into the plant-based protein segment with the recent successful launch of Saffola Meal Maker Soya Chunks and also strengthened its ready-to-eat portfolio with Saffola Oodles. The all-new Saffola Chyawanprash comes in three SKUs – 500 gram for Rs 199, 1 kilogram for Rs 350, and a 1.25 kilogram value pack exclusively for modern trade stores, all while promising consistent quality which is associated with the Saffola brand. The product is available across eCommerce, modern trade, and general platforms all over India, as well as the Saffola Store direct-to-consumer portal.
